control.name: CONTROL / #1674 regression proof — revert readNextUp to the pre-fix behaviour so it always reads the working-tree STATUS.md instead of origin/main; the sibling-staleness phantom returns and TestReadNextUp_ReadsBoardFromOriginMainNotStaleWorkingTree must go red

mutations.name: treat an unreadable origin/main ref as an authoritative EMPTY board — drop the honest working-tree fallback so a root that was never fetched (or is not a git repo) silently plans zero rows instead of degrading to the working tree with a could-not-check note (#1674); TestReadNextUp_FallsBackToWorkingTreeWhenNoOriginMain must catch it

example-stream/17 repair obligation — DROP the same-actor self-certification guard in RepairObligation.Resolve so the worker that produced a repair could resolve its own obligation at the repaired revision; TestRepairObligationMergeIsNotResolved must go red (a worker cannot independently verify itself)

example-stream/17 repair obligation — REGRESS the reconcile state-advance rule (> becomes <) so a duplicate/lost-ack append-only log folds to the LEAST-progressed state instead of the furthest; TestRepairObligationRestartAndDuplicate must go red (a claim then a lost-ack re-post would drop back to needs-assignment)

#1339 — DISABLE the fresh-lane represented reconciliation so an already-represented row falls through to fresh DISPATCH exactly as before the fix: the landed-unreconciled and open-PR-resume routing never fires. TestPlan_MergedRowIsLandedUnreconciledNotDispatched and TestPlan_OpenPRRowRoutedToResume must both go red (the merged row is offered for dispatch and no LANDED-UNRECONCILED heading appears; the open-PR row is offered as fresh instead of resume).

#1339 authoring exemption — DISABLE it so every PR naming a queued brief represents it first-wins, as before the fix: a MERGED docs-only PR that only AUTHORED the brief makes it read as landed-unreconciled again. TestPlan_AuthoringPRDoesNotLandBrief must go red (the brief is listed under LANDED-UNRECONCILED instead of offered for dispatch).

#5853 SKIP the per-brief lookup past an incomplete window, as before the fix: a todo row whose merged PR is older than the window is offered as IMPLEMENT again. TestPlan_WindowMissLookupLands must go red.
#5853 ROUND a failed lookup to not-found: the row falls through to IMPLEMENT instead of could-not-check. TestPlan_LookupErrorUnchecked must go red.
#5853 ALWAYS run the per-brief lookup, even over a complete window: one search per queued brief every plan. TestPlan_CompleteWindowNoLookup must go red.
#5853 look candidates up ALPHABETICALLY instead of in queue priority order: a rate limit then holds the same alphabetical tail every run. TestPlan_LookupPriorityOrder must go red.
